**About JD.com** 




 JD.com (NASDAQ: JD and HKEX: 9618\), also known as JINGDONG, has evolved from a pioneering e\-commerce platform into a leading technology and service provider with supply chain at its core. Renowned for its supply chain innovation and excellence, JD.com has expanded into sectors including retail, technology, logistics, healthcare, and more, aiming to transform traditional business models with cutting\-edge digital solutions. Ranked 47th on the Fortune Global 500, JD.com is China’s largest retailer by revenue.
 



  





**Our International Business** 




 We are dedicated to building a digitally intelligent, cross\-border supply chain and global retail infrastructure. Leveraging our global supply chain capabilities, JD.com continues to expand in markets where our competitive strengths shine. Currently, JD.com operates globally, with business activities in countries such as China, the U.S., U.K., Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Hungary, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and many others, reaching customers in every corner of the world.
 



  





 Learn more about us: https://corporate.jd.com/
 



  





**About role:** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Logistics Project Manager** 
 to lead the end\-to\-end execution of large\-scale, automated warehouse and sorting center projects across the Middle East. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical planning and physical execution, managing everything from site renovations and automation equipment installation to system integrations and operations launch. This position requires a structured leader who can orchestrate cross\-functional teams, manage external suppliers, and build regional standardization playbooks to ensure high\-quality, on\-time project delivery.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:** 



* **Project Lifecycle Management:** 
 This includes project initiation, making project plans, detailing project work content, adjusting project plans according to the actual situation, and coordinating with project stakeholders to complete the work, ensuring high\-quality project delivery .
* **On\-Site Construction \& Installation:** 
 Coordinating resources from all parties to ensure that the civil construction renovation, power and communication system, installation and commissioning of logistics automation equipment, and other tasks are carried out in an orderly manner, proceed as planned, and are delivered on time.
* **Project Delivery and Integration** 
 : Collaborating with planning, operations, R\&D, equipment supplier, and other parties, organizing project training, on\-site setup, warehouse relocation, and starting operation to ensure a smooth project launch.
* **Accumulation of Project Implementation Techniques and Standardization Construction** 
 : Based on the practice of Middle East project construction and operation, accumulate and compile Middle East project construction standards from the principles of compliance, efficiency, and economy, continuously iterate and improve to enhance the efficiency and quality of project construction.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements:** 



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree or higher in Industrial Engineering, Logistics \& Supply Chain Management, Automation, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 
 3\+ years in logistics project implementation. Proven track record managing automated warehousing or sorting center projects. Overseas or Middle East project experience is highly preferred.
* **Technical Skills:** 
 Strong data analytical capabilities. Proficient in structured thinking and at least one tool (Excel, SQL, or Python) to evaluate project metrics.
* **Communication \& Mobility:** 
 Fluent in English for global reporting and cross\-border vendor management. Ready to travel periodically across the Middle East region.
* **Soft Skills:** 
 Exceptional cross\-departmental coordination, vendor management, and the ability to extract scalable methodologies from complex field situations.

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of your Day**
 As a Project Procurement Manager you represent Supply Chain in the Project/Proposal Management Team and acts as the Sub\-project Manager leading the Project SCM strategy for Compressor packages. You will integrate procurement in the project management process and project teams and be involved during the sales phase. You will organize all procurement activities in a project under optimum deployment of resources. You also implement procurement strategies aiming to optimize project results, including availability of goods and services in quality, in time, in budget while ensuring observance of obligatory Procurement processes and regulations.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Early Involvement during sales phase: Analyze sales and operations planning in respect of starting/new projects in order to ensure the involvement of Procurement. Participate in project/sales meetings as project core team member to provide information about supply market, preferred suppliers and supplier innovation (regarding goods and services) at an early stage to optimize supplier strategy and selection of Major CTO and ETO equipment, such as Motors, Gears, Gas Engines, Acoustics equipment, Auxiliaries (Lube Systems, Gas Seal panels, etc); diversified components (Dry Gas Seals, Anti\-Surge Valves, other); extended scope such as WHRU, HRSG, Balance of Plant.
* Project Procurement standards: Establish proper sourcing processes, control all Procurement resources and activities in the project and inform all involved within Procurement to deliver optimum impact for the business (Procurement plan, target\-costing) relating to budget, availability, timeline and quality. Apply Procurement regulations as per Compliance, organization standards and PM@Siemens Energy
* Analysis: Analyze scope of supply, contractual obligations and exactly understand customer’s functional needs.Identify Procurement risks, opportunities, potential changes, claims and market forces during the entire project, together with Commodity Management, to avoid potential damage / exploit potential.
* Strategy definition and implementation: Derive Procurement strategy for assigned projects in accordance with Business Unit \& Operating Company Procurement strategies and ensure implementation. Introduce negotiation recommendations together with Commodity Management to prepare for negotiations with suppliers (back\-to\-back where appropriate) and to initiate appropriate measures.
* Negotiation: Lead complex contractual and price, cash flow and commercial T\&C negotiations and/or support the specialist buyers responsible for particular material fields (in particular those not covered by any Commodity Management) to secure project targets with optimum conditions on the basis of ToCO.
* Contract Management: Ensure that major Procurement risks, changes to original scope of supply and potential claims (towards customers and suppliers) are covered in valid contracts. Ensure that contractual obligations (towards the customer that must be fulfilled by supplier) are covered in a way that mitigates the own risk exposure.
* Supplier Management / Preferred Supplier List: Apply preferred supplier list (e.g. FPL), provide supplier information to the project team, coordinate Supplier Management in preparation for transition to Project execution phase (including Supplier Qualification, project\-specific supplier evaluations and supplier development).
* Knowledge management and documentation: Be proactive and forward systematically all relevant Procurement related project information (e.g. updated contractual conditions, Supplier Management data) to keep all project participants and relevant cross\-functional partners up to date. Share best practice and conduct lessons learn sessions. Sensitize cross\-functional partners for Procurement related practices processes and metrics.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) in an engineering discipline with minimum 5 years of relevant experience; or M.S. degree in engineering discipline with 3 years of relevant experience; or M.B.A with technical B.S. degree with 3 years of relevant experience; or equivalent education and experience.
* Compression and/or Gas Turbine major equipment relevant technical proficiency preferred
* 5 Years experience minimum combined in related SCM functions, Project Procurement, Proposal and/or Project Management within Oil and Gas or Power Generation industry.
* Advanced MS Office applications skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint
* Advanced knowledge of sourcing process
* Advanced negotiation skills
* Good problem solving skills
* Cost Modeling
* Ability to work in a matrix organization
* Advanced data analytics
* Leader, self\-manage
* Ability to run presentations to management level
* Availability to travel estimated 15% of time


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform

* Deep understanding of mobile platform limitations and how to work within them

* Strict adherence of legal requirementsDrive innovation and encourage continuous improvement and cost\-effective solutions without compromising quality.

* Outstanding interpersonal, written, and communication skills.
* Ability to organize work effectively and prioritize with high attention to detail.
* Excellent PC skills including MS Office products

data.jd_text:
The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end delivery of high\-end hospitality and residential development projects on behalf of the client. This role requires a proactive leader with a strong technical background in project and construction management, capable of managing design, procurement, construction, and handover phases while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cost control, and schedule adherence. The Senior Project Manager acts as the key interface between the client, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that the client’s vision and brand standards are achieved.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Project Leadership \& Planning
 


* Lead project delivery activities in alignment with company objectives and brand values.
* Develop, manage, and monitor project programs, budgets, and risk registers.
* Coordinate feasibility studies, site due diligence, and design development.
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, health and safety requirements, and sustainability objectives.



  





 Design \& Consultant Management
 


* Support the development team manage multidisciplinary design teams (architectural, interior design, MEP, structural, etc.) to ensure timely and coordinated outputs.
* Support the review of design documentation to ensure alignment with project brief, budget, and operational requirements.
* Facilitate design workshops and value engineering exercises.



  





 Procurement \& Contract Administration
 


* Support tendering and appointment of consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Review and recommend procurement strategies suitable for luxury hospitality and residential developments.
* Administer contracts in coordination with commercial and legal teams, ensuring compliance and fair execution.



  





 Construction \& Site Management
 


* Monitor construction progress, quality standards, and adherence to design intent.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings.
* Manage contractor performance and ensure timely resolution of technical and contractual issues.



  





 Stakeholder \& Client Interface
 


* Act as the principal client representative for all project\-related matters.
* Prepare and deliver regular project reports, presentations, and dashboards to senior management.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring alignment with project vision, cost, and delivery targets.



  





 Handover \& Closeout
 


* Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, and final handover processes.
* Ensure proper documentation, operation manuals, and as\-built drawings are delivered.
* Support transition to operations and post\-completion evaluations.



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education \& Certifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management (Master’s degree preferred).
* Professional accreditation such as PMP, RICS, MRICS, MCIOB, or equivalent is highly desirable.



  





 Experience
 


* Minimum 10–15 years of relevant experience, with at least 5 years in the UAE or GCC region.
* Proven track record of managing luxury hospitality and high\-end residential projects from inception to completion.
* Experience working within client or developer organizations preferred.
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC\-based contracts, local permitting processes, and regional construction practices.



  





 Skills \& Attributes
 


* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets and forecasts.
* High attention to detail with a commitment to delivering excellence.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with multicultural teams.

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

data.jd_text:
The Head of Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering function as a core competitive advantage for the System Integration Division. The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. The role also builds organizational capability by developing high\-performing engineering teams, strengthening supplier and OEM partnerships, and supporting bids, new solutions, and product development initiatives.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
****Job Responsibilities****
****Job Requirements****
**Engineering Strategy \& Technical Authority**
* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.
* Define and execute the technology roadmap including adoption of modern substation automation, IEC 61850 architectures, smart MCCs, and digitalization initiatives.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for major technical failures, NCRs, or quality concerns.


* Project Engineering \& Bid Management
* Provide technical leadership during bids, tenders, and proposal stage, ensuring optimal technical and commercial positioning.
* Validate technical compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee project engineering to ensure designs are delivered on time, within budget, and with zero major deviations.
* Manage interfaces with clients, consultants, OEMs (Siemens, ABB, GE, SEL, Schneider, etc.), and internal stakeholders.
* Balance standardization vs. customization to improve efficiency without compromising project requirements.
* Support business growth by enabling engineering capability for new markets, products, and solutions.
* Ensure seamless coordination with Testing \& Commissioning teams for successful system validation and handover.
* Departmental Leadership \& Capability Building
* Establish and lead a high\-performing engineering organization including Protection, Automation, Design, and Application Engineering.
* Define competency frameworks, skill matrix, and succession pipeline for critical roles.
* Drive recruitment, mentoring, and technical capability development.
* Optimize engineering resource planning across multiple concurrent projects.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Commercial \& Value Engineering
* Own engineering cost optimization through value engineering and design efficiency.
* Review and influence project profitability through technical decisions.
* Identify cost drivers within BOMs and propose alternatives without compromising performance.
* 
+ Support contract negotiations on technical clauses and deviations.

* Quality, Safety \& Compliance (Non\-Negotiables)
+ Ensure all engineering outputs comply with international standards including:
+ IEC 60255
+ IEC 61850
+ IEC 61131
+ IEC 61439
+ IEEE C37
+ ISO 9001
+ Integrate Safety by Design principles including arc\-flash mitigation, segregation, and isolation philosophy.
+ Ensure robust documentation control, ISO compliance, and accuracy of as\-built drawings and O\&M manuals.
+ Maintain centralized engineering data repository and knowledge management systems.


**Qualifications**
**Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (Master’s preferred).** 
****Experience****
* 15–18\+ years of relevant experience in Protection, Automation, Panel, or System Integration Engineering.
* Minimum 5–8 years in a senior engineering leadership or departmental head role.
* Experience handling multi\-million AED EPC or system integration projects is preferred


**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise** 
  

  

* Protection Engineering
+ Deep expertise in protection schemes (Differential, Distance, REF, Overcurrent, Busbar).
+ Relay coordination , system studies, and CT/VT sizing.

* Panel \& System Design
+ LV/MV panel design, heat dissipation, segregation, earthing, and wiring philosophy.

* Automation \& Communication
+ SCADA, RTU, IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870\-5 protocols.

* Engineering Tools
+ EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical
+ DIGSI, AcSELerator, EnerVista
+ ETAP / SKM

* Commercial Acumen
+ Strong understanding of technical specifications, BOM costing, value engineering, and project lifecycle

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! **Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

data.jd_text:
**Role Summary**
 The Customer Service Manager (CSM) is responsible for the day\-to\-day performance and stability of customer service operations in a fast\-paced fintech environment. This role requires a hands\-on, data\-driven leader with experience managing high\-volume call centre and digital support operations, capable of translating operational data into actionable insights. The CSM will drive service performance through queue management, capacity planning, root cause analysis (RCA), and Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, while working closely with internal teams and outsourced partners to deliver consistent, compliant, and high\-quality customer outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Insights (CSM Level)**
* Analyse customer service performance metrics including SLA, FCR, CSAT, NPS, AHT, backlog, abandonment, and repeat contacts
* Identify trends and drivers behind performance movements and translate them into clear operational actions
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for key issue types (e.g. remittance status checks, escalations, repeat contacts)
* Own and contribute to Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, highlighting recurring customer pain points and improvement opportunities
* Provide structured, insight\-led updates to the Head of Customer Service and senior stakeholders.


**Operational Service Delivery**
* Manage day\-to\-day customer service operations across voice, tickets, email, and in\-app support channels
* Oversee high\-volume call centre operations, ensuring queue health, responsiveness, and service stability
* Monitor ticket backlogs, ageing, and abandonment rates, taking corrective action where required
* Manage escalations, including coordination with internal teams and third\-party partners
* Lead and participate in daily stand\-ups to track performance, risks, and priorities


**Capacity Planning \& Workforce Management**
* Track service demand versus available capacity by channel and product
* Identify capacity gaps and support short\-term and medium\-term workforce planning
* Monitor agent productivity, utilisation, and adherence
* Support SLA and KPI discussions with outsourced partners using data\-backed insights


**CRM \& Process Discipline**
* Ensure consistent and accurate use of the CRM, including: a) Ticket logging and categorisation b) Status updates and escalation handling c) Routing and workflow adherence
* Maintain strong data hygiene to support reliable reporting and analysis
* Identify process inefficiencies or system gaps based on hands\-on operational experience


**People Leadership \& Team Enablement**
* Provide hands\-on coaching and real\-time guidance to agents and team leads
* Reinforce service quality standards, communication best practices, and escalation protocols
* Act as a first point of support for complex or sensitive customer cases
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus


**Requirements**
* Proven experience managing high\-volume call centre and digital support operations, ideally within fintech, banking, or financial services
* Strong data and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance metrics and drive actions
* Hands\-on experience with CRM systems (ticketing, routing, reporting)
* Experience leading RCA and VoC analysis to drive service and process improvements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including collaboration with Product, Tech, Risk, and outsourced partners.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, regulated environment Desirable.
* Experience working with outsourced BPO partners.
* Exposure to fintech products such as payments, wallets, lending, or merchant services.
* Understanding of regulatory and compliance considerations in customer service operations. Success Measures
* Improved SLA, FCR, CSAT, and abandonment performance
* Reduced backlog and ageing tickets.
* Clear, actionable RCA and VoC insights influencing operational improvements.
* Stable and predictable day\-to\-day service delivery.
* Improved agent productivity and consistency

data.jd_text:
**Head of Category \& Merchandising** 




  





 About the Role
 



  





 Fynde has partnered with a global cross\-border eCommerce platform that specialises in bringing international products to customers across the Middle East and wider international markets. With a strong presence across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, the business simplifies access to millions of global products by managing sourcing, import logistics, and last\-mile delivery through a seamless, consumer\-first digital experience.
 



  





 We are now headhunting a Head of Category \& Merchandising to take strategic and commercial ownership of category performance across the platform, with an initial focus on Health \& Supplements alongside broader involvement across multiple product categories within the organisation.
 



  





 Based in Dubai, this is a commercially driven leadership role focused on category growth, merchandising strategy, localisation, digital trading performance, and customer engagement across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider international markets. The position blends category management, product selection, pricing, ecommerce merchandising, analytics, and AI\-enabled optimisation, requiring someone capable of shaping both strategic direction and operational execution within a fast\-paced cross\-border ecommerce environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Category \& Commercial Ownership** 




 Lead the strategy, development, and ongoing performance management of key product categories across the platform, with a particular focus on Health \& Supplements. Drive revenue growth, margin optimisation, customer engagement, and category expansion in alignment with wider business objectives across multiple international markets.
 



  





**Assortment Development \& Curation** 




 Build commercially relevant and scalable product assortments based on customer behaviour, market trends, data analysis, and commercial opportunity. Continuously identify opportunities to strengthen category depth, introduce new products, and optimise the product mix across both regional and international audiences.
 



  





**Product Performance \& Trading Analysis** 




 Use dashboards, sales reporting, customer insights, and trading data to evaluate category performance and identify opportunities for optimisation. Analyse SKU performance, pricing effectiveness, conversion trends, promotional impact, and customer demand to drive commercial decision\-making.
 



  





**Pricing \& Promotional Strategy** 




 Develop and optimise pricing strategies in line with consumer expectations, competitive positioning, and margin objectives. Plan and execute promotional activity to support seasonal campaigns, category growth initiatives, and overall trading performance.
 



  





**Regional \& International Localisation** 




 Support the localisation and optimisation of category content, product presentation, and customer experience across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider international markets. Ensure merchandising strategies align with local consumer behaviours, cultural nuances, and evolving market expectations.
 



  





**AI \& Merchandising Automation** 




 Partner with data and technology teams to leverage AI, automation, and merchandising tools to improve category performance. Contribute towards initiatives involving product recommendations, dynamic pricing, search optimisation, inventory visibility, and broader ecommerce automation strategies.
 



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 Work closely with marketing, operations, supply chain, customer experience, and technology teams to ensure strong execution of category plans and alignment across all customer touchpoints.
 



  





**Market Intelligence \& Competitor Benchmarking** 




 Monitor developments across ecommerce, health \& wellness, consumer behaviour, and digital merchandising trends. Benchmark competitor activity, assortment strategy, pricing structures, and promotional campaigns to identify commercial opportunities and areas for improvement.
 



  





**Lifecycle \& Inventory Management** 




 Oversee the full lifecycle management of SKUs, ensuring products remain commercially viable, available, and aligned with category strategy. Collaborate with supply chain and operations teams to support forecasting, replenishment, and inventory optimisation.
 



 Requirements
 



  




* 5\+ years of experience within ecommerce category management, digital merchandising, ecommerce trading, or related commercial functions.
* Strong experience within Health, Supplements, Wellness, FMCG, Consumer Goods, or adjacent ecommerce\-led categories.
* Proven commercial acumen with responsibility for revenue growth, margin optimisation, product mix, and trading performance.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making capabilities with experience interpreting large datasets and translating insight into commercial action.
* Experience working alongside AI\-enabled merchandising tools, pricing engines, ecommerce CMS platforms, or automation technologies.
* Understanding of cross\-border ecommerce operations, digital marketplaces, and international trading environments.
* Experience operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, or wider Middle Eastern markets would be highly advantageous.
* Arabic language capabilities would be highly advantageous.
* Entrepreneurial, proactive, and commercially minded approach, with the ability to build, shape, and improve processes within a growing organisation.
* Ability to operate both strategically and hands\-on within a fast\-moving ecommerce environment.

data.jd_text:
The Executive Assistant (EA) will report to the Head of Middle East. This is a key role within the Middle East team. The successful candidate will bring substantial EA experience, gained within an international Law Firm(s) based in the Middle East. A high level of professionalism, discretion and commercial awareness is essential.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This is a full\-time, fixed\-term position of up to eight months to cover maternity leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9 00am to 6 00pm, with the option to work from home one day per week.
   

  




  


  

  

 We are seeking an agile, highly organised and responsive professional who is passionate about providing outstanding EA support to the Head of Middle East and contributing positively to the wider team. The role requires someone who can proactively manage competing priorities, build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and consistently deliver work to a high standard. The ideal candidate will take pride in going above and beyond, while exercising sound judgement and maintaining confidentiality at all times.
   

  

 Please note that, as part of the recruitment process, successful shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete Numeracy, Comprehension and Prioritisation assessments, which will take approximately 60 minutes in total.
   

  




  


**Please apply directly through with your application and kindly only contact our Recruitment team for any further details, legal experiance is essential part of the criteria for this role.**
  

  
   

  




  


 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Executive support, Diary \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This may include but is not limited to the following
   

  

 •Proactively manage the Head of Middle East’s complex and high‑volume diary, including scheduling internal and external meetings across multiple time zones, often involving numerous senior stakeholders with competing priorities.
   

  

 •Act as a gatekeeper for the Head of Middle East, triaging meeting requests, queries, issues and complaints, redirecting appropriately while ensuring matters are dealt with effectively and without unnecessary involvement from the Head.
   

  

 •Prepare agendas, attend meetings where the Head of Middle East is attending or chairing, take detailed notes and action logs, and proactively follow up with action owners to ensure completion within agreed timeframes.
   

  

 •Attend additional meetings alongside or on behalf of the Head of Middle East where appropriate, independently managing follow‑up actions and keeping the Head fully briefed.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East with strategic and commercial decision‑making by proactively preparing briefing materials, summaries, background information and data to ensure decisions are well‑informed.
   

  

 •Anticipate information requirements and liaise with Finance, BD, HR, Compliance and other Business Operations teams to ensure relevant input is available in advance of key meetings or decisions.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Travel, Logistics \& Trip Optimisation
   

  

 •Arrange end‑to‑end complex travel for the Head of Middle East, including multi‑destination international itineraries, coordination of different modes of transport, accommodation and airport transfers.
   

  

 •Manage all visas, permits and travel documentation, ensuring sufficient lead time and compliance with jurisdiction‑specific requirements.
   

  

 •Provide strategic input into travel planning, designing trips that maximise effectiveness by combining multiple objectives (client meetings, internal meetings, events and business development) into a single itinerary where possible.
   

  

 •Liaise extensively with colleagues across offices and business functions to ensure a joined‑up firm approach and maximise the value of each trip.
   

  

 •Remain flexible and responsive, managing last‑minute changes to travel and schedules calmly and efficiently when required.
   

  

 •Prepare detailed post‑trip reports summarising meetings held, key outcomes, opportunities identified and agreed next steps, for circulation to relevant internal stakeholders.
   

  

 •Ensure all follow‑up meetings and actions arising from travel are diarised promptly, tracked and progressed to completion.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Marketing / Business Development Support
   

  

 •Manage speaking engagements and thought‑leadership commitments, including tracking article and submission deadlines, coordinating preparatory research, and drafting briefing materials such as panel questions or speaker scripts.
   

  

 •Arrange and coordinate preparatory and briefing meetings in advance of panels, speaking slots or publications, ensuring the Head of Middle East is fully prepared.
   

  

 •Liaise with the Knowledge team and other internal stakeholders to obtain research support and background material where required, to ensure contributions are accurate, relevant and high quality.
   

  

 •Register the Head of Middle East for events when instructed and prepare comprehensive pre‑event briefings, including attendee information and engagement objectives, to maximise the value of attendance.
   

  

 •Working with the Head of Middle East and Business Development teams to maintain up‑to‑date client target lists.
   

  

 •Track and maintain updates on client target status, ensuring actions and deliverables assigned to relationship partners are followed up and progressed.
   

  

 •Provide regular status updates to the Head of Middle East on progress, upcoming actions and any slippage against agreed objectives.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Billing, Finance \& Expenses
   

  

 •Manage the full monthly billing process for the Head of Middle East’s matters, maintaining detailed knowledge of client fee agreements, caps and billing arrangements.
   

  

 •Prepare draft bills for approval, liaise with Finance as required, and issue final approved invoices to clients in their preferred format with appropriate covering correspondence.
   

  

 •Manage client billing queries in coordination with Finance and the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of expense submissions for the Head of Middle East, including liaising directly with vendors (restaurants and transport providers etc) to obtain duplicate receipts or supporting documentation where receipts were not provided or have been misplaced.
   

  

 •Ensure expenses are accurately described, correctly coded and supported by appropriate budget holder approval in line with firm policy.
   

  

 •Proactively follow up with clients regarding outstanding invoices and payments, providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East and keeping the Billing and Finance teams fully informed of progress, issues or agreed payment timelines.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Performance \& People Processes
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East throughout the performance review process, ensuring review meetings are scheduled in line with firm‑wide deadlines.
   

  

 •Prepare performance review meeting packs, ensuring all required documentation and financial data are available in advance.
   

  

 •Proactively monitor and follow up to ensure reviewees complete required system inputs ahead of meetings.
   

  

 •Attend performance review meetings to take detailed notes and assist the Head of Middle East during discussions.
   

  

 •Support completion of post‑meeting evaluations, notes and system requirements, ensuring timely and accurate submission.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of outstanding actions arising from performance reviews.

**About Us** 




 This marketing agency is hiring a commercially minded, hands\-on Media Strategist to own and scale paid campaigns across Google and Meta, while supporting expansion into new platforms.
 



 As a UK\-headquartered business operating globally, strong professional English communication is essential.
 



 You will take full ownership of assigned products, accountable for lead volume, CPA, quality, and margin performance. Reporting to the Head of Media, you’ll execute strategy while driving day\-to\-day optimisation and growth.
 



 This is a delivery\-focused role with clear commercial performance expectations — not a coordination position.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Owns paid media strategy and execution for assigned products
* Builds, launches, and scales campaigns across Google Ads and Meta
* Manages performance against clear CPA, ROAS, and margin targets
* Monitors campaigns daily and makes decisive optimisation changes
* Tests new creative approaches, audiences, bidding models, and landing page strategies
* Develops and iterates ad copy across Google and Meta, including RSA headline and description variants, Meta primary text and CTAs, and landing page messaging
* Briefs creative assets with clear strategic rationale and systematically tests messaging hypotheses using performance data to inform future iterations
* Contributes to expansion into new platforms such as YouTube, TikTok, Native, and Programmatic where commercially justified
* Collaborates closely with Tech, Ops, and Content teams to improve lead quality and conversion efficiency
* Uses data to generate insights by identifying trends, diagnosing issues, and proposing clear action plans
* Leverages generative AI tools to research products and markets, generate insights, and analyse campaign data to identify efficiency gains and commercial opportunities
* Provides structured and concise performance reporting to the Head of Media



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Has 3–7 years of experience managing paid media campaigns, with strong hands\-on expertise in Google Ads and Meta (5\+ years preferred)
* Demonstrates proven experience running lead generation campaigns with clear commercial accountability
* Has a strong track record of working against strict CPA and performance targets
* Possesses strong analytical capability and is comfortable working with performance data on a daily basis
* Demonstrates strong commercial awareness, with a clear understanding that success is measured by profitability and scalability rather than traffic alone
* Brings experience across additional platforms such as Bing, YouTube, Native, TikTok, and similar channels, which is considered advantageous
* Has experience marketing within regulated sectors such as financial services, insurance, legal, or healthcare; familiarity with FCA advertising standards or equivalent is highly advantageous
* Actively uses generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent platforms as part of daily workflow, including copy generation, creative briefing, performance analysis, and reporting
* Demonstrates exceptional written and spoken English fluency at a business and client\-ready level
* Has experience marketing products within the UK or other native English\-speaking markets, which is considered highly advantageous
* Exhibits a high\-ownership mentality and thrives in a results\-driven environment
* Is most likely currently based in Dubai, although exceptional candidates requiring relocation support may also be considered



  





**What the company offers:** 



* Offers a competitive salary alongside a monthly performance\-based bonus structure typically valued at approximately 15% of gross salary
* Provides clear performance accountability with strong opportunities for career progression
* Enables direct involvement in strategic decision\-making across multiple verticals, supported by a short reporting line and genuine commercial ownership of accounts from day one
* Presents a high\-impact, high\-autonomy role within a growing media team
* Supports a flexible working culture, including remote working where appropriate
* Offers the opportunity to work within a business actively investing in innovation and AI\-enabled marketing

The First Group Hospitality is a Dubai\-headquartered, full\-service hospitality management company specialising in hotel operations, asset management, and F\&B strategy. With a team of industry veterans and a proven track record, the company delivers tailored solutions that enhance efficiency, optimise revenue, and maximise asset value for investors and hotel owners.
   

  

 As a trusted third\-party hotel management provider, The First Group Hospitality partners with leading global brands to drive operational excellence and long\-term profitability, thanks to expertise spanning property performance optimisation, cost management, and guest experience enhancement.
   

  

 Beyond management, The First Group Hospitality develops and operates a dynamic portfolio of upscale hotels, residences, and award\-winning restaurants, creating high\-value hospitality assets that stand out in the market. For more information, visit tfghospitality.com
   

  

 The Director of Revenue Management is responsible for maximizing revenue growth and optimizing profitability across all revenue\-generating channels in the hotel. This role entails setting and executing pricing strategies, managing inventory, and analyzing market data to drive revenue performance. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with deep analytical expertise and a strong understanding of market trends, customer behavior, and distribution channels.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
- Strategic Revenue Management

* Develop and implement revenue management strategies and pricing models to maximize room revenue and market share.
* Conduct regular revenue analysis and forecasting to inform business decisions and strategic planning.
* Monitor competitive market trends and adjust pricing strategies as necessary to maintain a competitive edge.


- Inventory and Pricing Control

* Oversee the distribution and management of room inventory across all booking channels.
* Set room rates, packages, and promotions based on forecasted demand, market conditions, and competitive intelligence.
* Manage and optimize distribution channels, including OTAs, brand website, GDS, and other online and offline channels.


- Performance Analysis

* Track, analyze, and report on key revenue metrics, including RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, and market share.
* Regularly review and interpret revenue performance reports to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior management to support revenue and profitability goals.


- Cross\-Departmental Collaboration

* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, and Operations teams to align revenue strategies with overall business goals.
* Provide training and guidance to sales and front office teams on revenue management principles and upselling techniques.
* Work closely with marketing teams to develop promotions and campaigns that drive occupancy and ADR.


- Technology and Systems Management

* Utilize revenue management software (e.g., RMS, CRS, PMS) to manage data and make data\-driven decisions.
* Oversee the implementation and maintenance of technology solutions that support revenue management processes.
* Ensure data integrity and accuracy in revenue management systems and processes.


- Market Intelligence

* Conduct ongoing competitive analysis, including pricing, positioning, and market trends.
* Keep abreast of industry changes, new technologies, and best practices in revenue management.
* Develop market segmentation and customer profiling strategies to enhance targeting and pricing precision.


- Budgeting and Forecasting

* Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process for all revenue streams, including rooms, F\&B, and ancillary services.
* Ensure that revenue targets align with overall financial goals and provide regular updates on performance against budget.
* Identify opportunities to increase incremental revenue through upsell programs and ancillary offerings.
* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field
* Minimum 7\-10 years of experience in Revenue Management within the hospitality industry
* At least 3\-5 years in a leadership or multi\-property revenue management role
* Strong knowledge of hotel distribution channels, pricing strategies, and market segmentation
* Experience working with major hotel PMS, RMS, CRS, and channel management systems.
* Proven track record of driving RevPAR, ADR, and occupancy growth Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and act on complex data sets.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present to senior management and influence key stakeholders.

 The role has clear accountability for RevPAR, market share, total revenue, profitability\-aligned growth, brand\-aligned commercial execution and the development of a high\-performing commercial culture across the organization. The ideal candidate is a proven commercial leader with successful experience in a similar hotel organization and a demonstrated track record of managing luxury lifestyle in a complex environment as well as critical asset importance.
   

  

 Sales and Marketing Teams report directly to the Senior Commercial Director, ensuring clear ownership of demand generation, brand activation, commercial execution and revenue delivery across all commercial disciplines.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Commercial Strategy and Leadership**
* Develop, lead and execute the hotel strategy ensuring alignment with ownership objectives, brand standards, annual budgets and hotel business plans.
* Act as the senior commercial partner to the Managing Director, providing clear recommendations on business mix, pricing, demand generation, channel strategy and growth opportunities.
* Translate objectives into measurable commercial action plans with clear ownership, timelines and performance expectations.
* Create a strong commercial culture across the organization, ensuring hotel teams understand market opportunities, revenue priorities and their role in driving commercial results.


**RevPAR, Total Revenue and Market Share Growth**
* Drive RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, market share and total revenue growth across the asset through disciplined commercial planning and execution.
* Lead total hotel revenue opportunities across rooms, food and beverage, groups, meetings and events, long\-stay, corporate, leisure and ancillary revenue streams.
* Work closely with revenue management teams to optimize pricing, inventory controls, restrictions, forecasting, segmentation and channel mix.
* Identify demand gaps and growth opportunities by monitoring market trends, competitor activity, city\-wide events, source markets and changing customer behaviour.
* Ensure commercial decisions are profitability\-aligned, balancing revenue growth with distribution costs, margin impact and long\-term account value.


**Sales, Marketing, Distribution and Brand Activation**
* Lead the overall sales strategy across key segments including corporate, leisure, groups, MICE, wholesale, consortia, travel trade, OTA and direct channels.
* Ensure strategic account management disciplines are in place, including account plans, production reviews, relationship mapping, conversion tracking and measurable action plans.
* Oversee commercial input into marketing, PR, digital, e\-commerce, CRM, loyalty and promotional campaigns to drive demand and conversion for each hotel.
* Maximize the use of IHG commercial platforms, Vignette Collection brand opportunities, distribution systems, loyalty channels and shared\-service resources.
* Prioritize Brand.com and overall direct business revenue generation, increasing direct booking contribution, improving channel profitability and reducing reliance on third\-party channels where commercially appropriate.
* Further leverage One Rewards, IHG's loyalty ecosystem and the Vignette Collection brand platform to capture direct business, drive member engagement, strengthen repeat demand and grow loyalty\-led revenue across the portfolio.
* Provide direct leadership and accountability for Sales and Marketing teams, ensuring both functions are aligned behind the hotel commercial strategy, revenue targets and brand priorities.
* Represent the hotel at asset management reviews, key client meetings, brand reviews, trade events, sales missions and commercial forums when required.


**Team Management and Performance**
* Lead, coach and develop commercial teams and relevant on\-property colleagues, creating a results\-driven and collaborative working environment.
* Set clear individual and team KPIs, monitor performance regularly and provide timely feedback, coaching and corrective action where needed.
* Build team capability through training, succession planning, best\-practice sharing and consistent commercial routines.
* Ensure strong communication and coordination between sales, revenue, marketing, reservations, events, F\&B and hotel operations teams.
* Direct the Sales Leader and Marketing Leader with clearly defined responsibilities, reporting routines, KPIs and accountability for revenue\-generating activities.


**Above\-Property and Shared\-Service Collaboration**
* Build strong and productive relationships with above\-property and shared\-service teams, including IHG/brand commercial support, revenue management, digital, distribution, reservations, loyalty, PR and marketing resources.
* Influence and coordinate shared\-service support to ensure hotel priorities are understood, actioned and measured against expected results.
* Translate above\-property initiatives into property\-level execution, ensuring hotel receives the right level of commercial focus and follow\-through.
* Escalate risks, opportunities and resources needs clearly to the Managing Director and senior leadership team.


**Business Planning, Reporting and Analysis**
* Lead and contribute to annual business planning, budgeting, forecasting and commercial reviews.
* Prepare clear commercial reports and presentations for the Managing Director, senior management and relevant stakeholders.
* Use data from PMS, CRS, RMS, CRM, sales reporting and business intelligence tools to identify trends, risks and actionable opportunities.
* Track progress against commercial plans, revenue targets, pace, pickup, conversion, account production and campaign performance.


**Operational and Stakeholder Alignment**
* Work closely with hotel operations teams to ensure commercial promises are aligned with guest experience, service delivery and operational capacity.
* Partner with food and beverage leaders to create demand, packages, promotions and partnerships that grow total revenue and enhance hotel positioning.
* Maintain strong relationships with asset management/owners, brand representatives, key clients, partners and internal stakeholders to support long\-term commercial success.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* RevPAR, ADR, occupancy and market share index performance.
* Total revenue delivery, including rooms, food and beverage, meetings and events, and ancillary revenue versus budget and forecast.
* Sales productivity, account penetration, conversion, pipeline quality and business mix improvement.
* Channel mix optimization, direct booking contribution, loyalty performance and distribution cost efficiency.
* com production, direct business revenue contribution, One Rewards and loyalty contribution, member engagement and repeat demand.
* Forecast accuracy, pricing discipline, commercial plan execution and speed of corrective action.
* Team engagement, talent development and quality of collaboration with hotel leadership and shared\-service teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Hospitality Management, Commercial Strategy, Marketing or a related field; master’s degree or relevant certification is an advantage.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive hotel commercial, sales, revenue, distribution or marketing leadership experience, including 3\-5 years in a senior commercial role.
* Proven track record of delivering RevPAR, total revenue, market share, Brand.com/direct\-channel growth, loyalty revenue and profitable commercial performance.
* Prior international chain with lifestyle brand experience is strongly preferred.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen across rooms, F\&B, groups, events, pricing, segmentation, distribution, digital/e\-commerce, CRM, brand marketing and demand generation.
* Proven ability to lead Sales and Marketing teams, with clear reporting lines, KPIs, performance routines, coaching and accountability across a multi\-property environment.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership, owners, brand teams, shared\-service teams, clients and partners.
* Proficiency with hotel commercial systems, including PMS, CRS, RMS, CRM, sales reporting and business intelligence tools.
* Knowledge of the Dubai/UAE hospitality market and international source markets is strongly preferred; fluent English is required and additional languages are preferred.
* Flexibility to travel and attend client meetings, industry events and commercial activities as required.

**Fund Sales Business Development Director**

**Intro:** 




 The Fund Sales Business Development Director (BDD) is responsible for originating and winning new fund services business across the United Arab Emirates, with a primary focus on the fund management community. Working closely with colleagues across Sales, Markets, and Global Financial Solutions, you will build pipelines, lead the end\-to\-end sales cycle, and convert opportunities into long\-term client relationships. You will represent CSC® externally with fund managers, asset managers, financial institutions, and key referral partners such as law firms and professional services firms. This role is suited to a high\-energy “hunter” with a strong network and a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
 



  





**Some of the things you’ll be doing:** 



* Proactively originate, qualify, and win new fund sales opportunities across the UAE.
* Build and maintain a strong referral network with external business partners (including law firms and professional services firms), deepening existing relationships and unlocking new referral sources.
* Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including discovery, solution positioning, presentations, deal management, follow\-ups, and negotiation.
* Collaborate with Global Financial Solutions and Markets teams to position CSC’s product suite, including fund administration, SPV services, depositary, AIFM, and strategic outsourcing solutions.
* Develop account and territory plans, including go\-to\-market activity plans, aligned to revenue targets and strategic priorities.
* Coordinate and contribute to proposals and RFP responses in partnership with the Funds Market team and other subject matter experts.
* Conduct deal\-by\-deal risk assessment and ensure new opportunities meet internal governance, regulatory expectations, and commercial criteria.
* Monitor market and competitor trends and provide actionable insights to support commercial strategy and growth planning.
* Represent CSC at client meetings, industry forums, conferences, and seminars to promote brand visibility and generate pipeline.
* Use sales tools and technology (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Preqin or similar platforms) to manage pipeline, forecasting, activity tracking, and reporting.








**What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?** 



* Demonstrated success in a business development / sales role with consistent achievement against quotas or revenue targets (new business acquisition focus).
* Experience selling to, or within, the fund management community (e.g., fund managers, asset managers, financial institutions) or selling closely related financial services solutions into that client base.
* Strong network within the fund management community and ability to build referral channels with law firms and professional services partners.
* Proven ability to run complex, consultative sales cycles, coordinate internal stakeholders, and close deals.
* Strong commercial judgement, negotiation skills, and ability to assess opportunity risk and fit.
* Proficiency with CRM and sales enablement tools, including Salesforce (or similar), with disciplined pipeline management and forecasting.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Knowledge of fund servicing models and products such as fund administration, depositary, AIFM, SPVs, or strategic outsourcing.
* Existing partner relationships across the UAE fund management community.
* Experience selling regulated services and navigating governance, compliance, and risk review processes during onboarding.
* Strong presentation skills and experience representing an organisation at industry events and conferences.








**A typical career progression** 
 path could look like: Business Development Director → Senior Business Development Director / Sales Leader → Regional Sales Head / Commercial Director (Funds).
 



 Cross\-functional opportunities: pathways into Product Strategy, Funds Market Leadership, Key Account Management, or broader Global Financial Solutions commercial leadership roles.
 



 Compensation: competitive salary plus a commission plan aligned to individual performance and revenue outcomes (details discussed during the interview process), with access to CSC benefits and additional incentives as applicable.
 



  





**Why work with CSC?** 




 At CSC®, we’re always looking ahead, finding ways to improve and anticipate the future needs of our customers. Curiosity fuels our innovation and productivity drives our results. This proactive mindset has helped us adapt and create solutions that have enabled businesses to run smoother and smarter for more than 120 years.
 



 CSC is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented people whose personal values align with ours. We empower our employees to bring the right solutions to market to meet customer demand. That is why we are the premier provider of global solutions for more than 180,000 businesses.
 



  




* CSC is a great place to work with smart and dedicated people.
* We have been voted a Top Workplace every year since 2006\.
* We offer challenging work and career opportunities. Most positions are filled with internal moves and employee referrals.
* Employees are eligible for success sharing, bonus, or commission plans based on role and individual performance.
* CSC offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package as part of your Total Rewards that includes annual leave, tuition reimbursement, employee referral bonuses, and more.



  





**About us** 




 CSC is a global business, legal, and financial services company based in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, providing knowledge\-based solutions to clients worldwide. We have offices and capabilities in over 140 jurisdictions in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East, and more than 8,000 colleagues. We are the business behind business.®
 



 CSC is committed to creating a diverse and growth\-oriented environment where everyone is valued and respected. CSC offers challenging career opportunities and excellent benefits, including annual success\-sharing bonuses or commission plans based on individual performance. To learn more, visit cscglobal.com/service/careers.
 



  





 Visit our careers site to learn more about CSC and our commitment to our clients, communities, and each other.

data.jd_text:
Who We Are
   

  

 At Inverto in Riyadh, we’re defining what’s next in procurement and supply chain—driven by ambition, precision, and impact. With the strength of BCG behind us and a sharp entrepreneurial mindset at our core, we partner with leading global organizations to deliver strategies that create lasting value.
   

  

 Our people are central to that mission. As experts who move with intent and momentum, we continually invest in developing our capabilities, expanding our reach, and scaling our impact. Growth at Inverto is shared growth\-opening new opportunities for our clients, our business, and our teams.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The Business \& Operations Senior Manager drives the effective operationalization of Inverto’s regional growth agenda by leading key commercial, people, financial, and operational processes for the Middle East.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic partner to Inverto leadership and EMESA teams, the role ensures transparency in business development activities, enables strong go\-to\-market execution, and supports high\-quality decision\-making through robust performance and financial management. It plays a central role in shaping and sustaining talent and team development, driving a cohesive and high\-performing culture, and ensuring optimal staffing and resource allocation.
   

  

 The position also safeguards operational excellence by strengthening cross\-functional collaboration with BCG Core and Inverto EMESA, ensuring reliable data flow, and securing compliance with governance, legal, and internal standards. Additionally, it oversees local office operations and orchestrates shared services and marketing initiatives to enable seamless delivery and reinforce Inverto’s brand presence in the region.
   

  

 A key aspect of the role is ensuring alignment between BCG core and Inverto\-specific requirements, in accordance with Inverto’s global guardrails, and business model.
   

  

 Overall, the role is critical in enabling the Middle East business to operate effectively, grow sustainably, and achieve its strategic objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Management and GTM support
* Partner with Inverto Managing Directors, Principals, and Inverto EMESA to operationalize the Inverto growth plan and operating model by translating strategic priorities into actionable initiatives and effective execution
* Liaise with the Inverto Business Excellence team and local Inverto leadership to ensure full transparency in the BD pipeline, including tool management / data accuracy, process alignment, and effective governance of local Inverto leads
* Enable commercial success by creating visibility into local platforms (e.g., local BCG lead calls), synthesizing insights, and supporting senior stakeholders with actionable steering information
* People \& Talent Management
* Drive optimal team deployment and resource allocation in close collaboration with the Inverto EMESA team, ensuring sustained delivery capacity and alignment with business needs
* Shape the Middle East hiring strategy jointly with Inverto EMESA and local recruiting teams, contributing to the attraction and retention of top consulting talent and enhancing the effectiveness of selection processes
* Coordinate and improve professional development initiatives \- including career development, training, retention, and team affiliation \- liaising with EMESA team
* Lead local people\-related initiatives that strengthen team cohesion and organizational culture
* Ensure smooth HR operations and benefits implementation in collaboration with local HR teams
* Support driving the Teaming process in partnership with Inverto’s central Teaming Team, ensuring effectiveness and continuous improvement.
* Financial Planning \& Performance Management
* Collaborate with Finance teams to steer annual strategic and financial planning processes, ensuring alignment between functional priorities and financial targets
* Ensure rigorous budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting, translating data into insights and recommendations for senior leadership
* Liaise with Inverto and BCG Finance teams to ensure accurate cost accounting and P\&L management against Plan
* Support Inverto Commercial Finance in maintaining full transparency of the project portfolio, enabling informed decision\-making on performance and risk management
* Collaboration \& Data flow
* Maintain strong and effective collaboration with BCG Core and Inverto EMESA teams (BST, HR, IT, etc.), enhancing cross\-functional processes and ensuring smooth operational integration
* Ensure reliable information and data flow between Inverto Middle East and Inverto EMESA, including oversight of non\-automated processes and adherence to data governance standards
* Risk Management \& Compliance Coordination
* Support governance, risk management, and compliance efforts by ensuring alignment of local operations with Inverto EMESA and BCG Core requirements, while proactively identifying improvement areas
* Ensure compliance with legal standards and internal policies, implementing effective local controls and maintaining transparency on regulatory updates
* Establish processes to systematically gather and synthesize up\-to\-date information on relevant compliance regulations
* Local Coordination \& Office Enablement
* Oversee day\-to\-day office operations of the Inverto team and act as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring smooth and efficient business operations
* Coordinate shared services and functions (e.g., HR, Recruiting, IT) with BCG where applicable, optimizing processes to support local delivery
* Drive local marketing initiatives and ensure consistent execution of campaigns in alignment with global teams (Global Inverto Marketing and Global Employer Branding), maintaining a unified and compelling brand presence


 What You'll Bring
   

  

 Bachelors or Masters degree with an above\-average grade.
   

  

 8\+ years of relevant experience within business operations
   

  

 Confident presence in an international environment, business fluent in English.
   

  

 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 Reporting to the Inverto Managing Director
   

  

 Working with global, regional and local teams
   

  

 Hyper motivated individuals
   

  

 Entrepreneurs and those that have a growth mindset
   

  

 Teammates that are authentic by nature, they thrive to support the team to win
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
   

  

 BCG is an E \- Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E\-Verify.
